author: Nelev
body:
## Summary

- Adds a shadcn `Sidebar` beside the chat panel with a single section: the user's past conversations, listed by title (`components/app-sidebar.tsx`).
- It collapses to an icon rail (`collapsible="icon"`), so the toggle in its header stays on screen; collapsed rows show their title as a tooltip. On phones the sidebar is a sheet, opened from a toggle passed into `ChatHeader` through a new optional `leading` slot (so `loading.tsx`, which renders the header outside the provider, is unaffected).
- The list comes from a **stub** in `api/conversations.ts`. medas-api has no `GET /conversations` yet; the stub documents the contract it stands in for, and swapping in the fetch touches only that file. Items are display-only for now.
- The page starts the list alongside the greeting fetch rather than after it.
- One `TooltipProvider` now wraps the app in `app/layout.tsx`, as shadcn's sidebar expects.
- `hooks/use-mobile.ts` reads the media query with `useSyncExternalStore` instead of shadcn's set-state-in-effect version, which the React lint rejects. Existing customised `button`, `input` and `tooltip` components were kept, not overwritten by the shadcn CLI.

## Known gaps

- Clicking a conversation does nothing yet.
- `loading.tsx` has no sidebar, so the panel shifts sideways when the page resolves.

## Test plan

- [ ] `yarn lint && yarn format:check && yarn tsc --noEmit && yarn test` (41 passing, including new `components/app-sidebar.test.tsx`: lists titles, collapses to the icon rail keeping the toggle, empty state)
- [ ] Manually check desktop collapse/expand and the phone sheet in the browser (not verified yet: the preview was behind Clerk sign-in)
